newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Caltex appoints Lonergan Singapore MD.
newsitem.headline: Caltex appoints Lonergan Singapore MD.

text.p: Caltex Group of Companies has appointed Leo Lonergan as managing director to replace Clifton Hon, a company statement said on Wednesday.
The appointment is part of a wider restructuring, which included cutting Singapore staff by 50 or 15 percent.
Caltex is equally owned by Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
Lonergan is transferring from Caltex Dubai, where as managing director of Caltex Alkhalij he was responsible for operations in 12 countries in the Middle East and South Asia.
Hon has moved to the Philippines to take up a position as country head for Caltex, the statement said.
